statements:
CREATE TABLE "AgendaDigestDelivery" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "revisionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "planningDate" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "deliveredAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT "AgendaDigestDelivery_userId_revisionId_key" UNIQUE ("userId", "revisionId"),
      FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("revisionId") REFERENCES "AgendaRevision" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "AgendaItem" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "revisionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "goalId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "sectionId" TEXT,
      "itemType" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "plannedDate" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "estimatedMinutes" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "explanation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "explanationCode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "completedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "reviewDueAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "reviewCardId" TEXT,
      "cognitiveEntityIds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "targetState" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "expectedEvidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "sortIndex" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      FOREIGN KEY ("revisionId") REFERENCES "AgendaRevision" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("goalId") REFERENCES "LearningGoal" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("sectionId") REFERENCES "UnitSection" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "AgendaRevision" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "planningDate" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "capacityMinutes" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "capacityJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
      "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily',
      "generationSource" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deterministic',
      "contentHash" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      "activatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "AgentMessage" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "threadId" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "toolCalls" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "toolCallId" TEXT, "uiPayload" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "metadataJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY ("threadId") REFERENCES "AgentThread" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "AgentThread" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "userId" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "scopeId" TEXT,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "stateJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "AiGenerationRun" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "userId" TEXT,
        "scope" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "scopeId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "operation" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
        "eventsJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        "tokenPreview" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "statusMessage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "resultJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "errorMessage" TEXT,
        "nextEventSequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT "AiGenerationRun_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "AiGenerationRunEvent" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "runId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
        "type" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "payload" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "snapshotKey" TEXT,
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        CONSTRAINT "AiGenerationRunEvent_runId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("runId") REFERENCES "AiGenerationRun"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "ApiRequestLog" (
    "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "requestId" TEXT NOT NULL, "traceId" TEXT NOT NULL, "userId" TEXT,
    "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "route" TEXT NOT NULL, "statusCode" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "durationMs" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requestBytes" INTEGER, "responseBytes" INTEGER,
    "platform" TEXT, "ipHash" TEXT, "userAgentHash" TEXT, "errorCode" TEXT,
    "errorMessage" TEXT, "errorFingerprint" TEXT
  )

CREATE TABLE "BackendErrorGroup" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "service" TEXT NOT NULL, "errorName" TEXT, "errorCode" TEXT, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "stack" TEXT, "statusCode" INTEGER, "method" TEXT, "route" TEXT, "operation" TEXT, "firstSeenAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "lastSeenAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "occurrenceCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE "ChatNarrationAudio" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "sectionId" TEXT,
      "scopeKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "contentKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "textHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "provider" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "model" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "speaker" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "timingVersion" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'building',
      "generationStartedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "error" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "objectKey" TEXT,
      "mimeType" TEXT,
      "durationMs" INTEGER,
      "chars" JSON,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      CONSTRAINT "ChatNarrationAudio_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "ChatNarrationAudio_unitId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "ChatNarrationAudio_sectionId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("sectionId") REFERENCES "UnitSection" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "ChatNarrationAudio_identity_unique" UNIQUE ("userId", "unitId", "scopeKey", "contentKey", "textHash", "provider", "model", "speaker")
    )

CREATE TABLE "CognitiveConstruct" (
        "entityId" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "constructType" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "objective" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "performanceCriteria" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        "contextSchema" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "inputs" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        "outputs" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        "qualityCriteria" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        "compositionStrategy" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveConstruct_entityId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("entityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "CognitiveEntity" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "stableKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "scopeKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'goal',
        "ownerUserId" TEXT,
        "goalId" TEXT,
        "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto',
        "definitionVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
        "provenance" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveEntity_ownerUserId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("ownerUserId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveEntity_goalId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("goalId") REFERENCES "LearningGoal"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "CognitiveModelRevision" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "goalId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "version" INTEGER NOT NULL,
        "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'candidate',
        "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
        "inputHash" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "snapshotSchemaVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        "isFullSnapshot" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
        "snapshotJson" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "auditJson" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "errorJson" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        "publishedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveModelRevision_goalId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("goalId") REFERENCES "LearningGoal"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "CognitiveRelation" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "ownerCurriculumKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "sourceEntityId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "targetEntityId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "relationType" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "strength" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        "required" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        "rationale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
        "introducedModelVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        "deprecatedModelVersion" INTEGER,
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveRelation_sourceEntityId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("sourceEntityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveRelation_targetEntityId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("targetEntityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT "CognitiveRelation_ownerCurriculumKey_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("ownerCurriculumKey") REFERENCES "LearningUnit"("curriculumKey") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "ConstructComponent" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "constructId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "componentEntityId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "relationType" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'composed_of',
        "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'primary',
        "requirementMode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'required',
        "componentGroup" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "threshold" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.7,
        "gate" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        "weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        "orderIndex" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        "rationale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        CONSTRAINT "ConstructComponent_constructId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("constructId") REFERENCES "CognitiveConstruct"("entityId") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT "ConstructComponent_componentEntityId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("componentEntityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE "ContentVerificationAudit" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "runId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "artifactKind" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "blockCount" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "repairedCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "issuesJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY ("runId") REFERENCES "AiGenerationRun" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "CornellNote" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      "notes" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "cues" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "summary" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT "CornellNote_unitId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "DeepPlanningResearchLease" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "ownerKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "goalId" TEXT,
      "moduleKey" TEXT,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "queuedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      "acquiredAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "heartbeatAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "expiresAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "releasedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

CREATE TABLE "DiagnosticAttempt" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "questions" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "answers" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "results" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "perLearningTargetResults" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ready',
      "overallScore" REAL,
      "passed" BOOLEAN,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "submittedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      CONSTRAINT "DiagnosticAttempt_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "DiagnosticAttempt_unitId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "DomainEventDelivery" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "eventId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "subscriberId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
      "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "nextAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "processingStartedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "lastAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "deliveredAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "deadLetteredAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "lastError" TEXT,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT "DomainEventDelivery_eventId_fkey"
        FOREIGN KEY ("eventId") REFERENCES "DomainEventOutbox" ("id")
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "DomainEventDelivery_eventId_subscriberId_key"
        UNIQUE ("eventId", "subscriberId")
    )

CREATE TABLE "DomainEventOutbox" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "type" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "schemaVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      "idempotencyKey" TEXT UNIQUE,
      "userId" TEXT,
      "goalId" TEXT,
      "unitId" TEXT,
      "threadId" TEXT,
      "payload" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "occurredAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      "fanoutCompletedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE "EventOutbox" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "type" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "payload" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "publishedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
        "attemptCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        "nextAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3) DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        "lastError" TEXT,
        "deadLetteredAt" TIMESTAMP(3)
      )

CREATE TABLE "EvidenceClaim" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "observationId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "cognitiveEntityId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "learningTargetId" TEXT,
      "misconceptionPatternId" TEXT,
      "dimension" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "criterionRef" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "polarity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'supports',
      "score" REAL NOT NULL CHECK ("score" BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
      "strength" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("strength" BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
      "evaluatorReliability" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("evaluatorReliability" BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
      "groundingReliability" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("groundingReliability" BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
      "definitionVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("definitionVersion" > 0),
      "contextKey" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      "idempotencyKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "validFrom" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "validUntil" TIMESTAMP,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceClaim_observationId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("observationId") REFERENCES "TaskObservation"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceClaim_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceClaim_cognitiveEntityId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("cognitiveEntityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceClaim_learningTargetId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("learningTargetId") REFERENCES "LearningTarget"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceClaim_misconceptionPatternId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("misconceptionPatternId") REFERENCES "MisconceptionPattern"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "EvidenceLifecycleEvent" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "evidenceClaimId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "eventType" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "actorUserId" TEXT,
      "replacementClaimId" TEXT,
      "payload" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceLifecycleEvent_evidenceClaimId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("evidenceClaimId") REFERENCES "EvidenceClaim"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceLifecycleEvent_actorUserId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("actorUserId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      CONSTRAINT "EvidenceLifecycleEvent_replacementClaimId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("replacementClaimId") REFERENCES "EvidenceClaim"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FeynmanSession" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "userText" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "feedback" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "passed" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      CONSTRAINT "FeynmanSession_unitId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FlashCard" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "deckId" TEXT NOT NULL, "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "cognitiveEntityId" TEXT NOT NULL, "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "anchorJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "sourceExcerpt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generated', "sortOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "due" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL, "stability" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "difficulty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "elapsedDays" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "scheduledDays" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New',
      "lastReview" TIMESTAMP(3), "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY ("deckId") REFERENCES "FlashCardDeck" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("cognitiveEntityId") REFERENCES "CognitiveEntity" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FlashCardDeck" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      "cardCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "generatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "sourceHash" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      FOREIGN KEY ("unitId") REFERENCES "LearningUnit" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FlashCardReview" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "cardId" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "reviewedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY ("cardId") REFERENCES "FlashCard" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FormalDerivationCheckpoint" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "runId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "stepOrdinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "stateJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY ("runId") REFERENCES "FormalDerivationRun"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "FormalDerivationRun" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
      "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "locale" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "schemaVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "promptVersion" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "requirementJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "documentJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "eventsJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "nextEventSequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "operation" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "routedProvider" TEXT,
      "routedModel" TEXT,
      "validationSummaryJson" TEXT,
      "tokenSummaryJson" TEXT,
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "completedAt" TIMESTAMP(3)
    , "ownerUserId" TEXT, "unitId" TEXT, "sectionId" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "FormalDerivationStep" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "runId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "baseRevision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "afterRevision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "actionsJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "presentationJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "metadataJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY ("runId", "id"),
      FOREIGN KEY ("runId") REFERENCES "FormalDerivationRun"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "GlobalGenerationSettings" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 'global',
      "deepPlanningResearchConcurrency" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
      "chatAudioProvider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'minimax',
      "searchEnabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "searchProvider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tavily',
      "imageProvider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "openaiBaseUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official',
      "contentVerificationMode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off',
      "contentVerificationProvider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek',
      "contentVerificationModel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek-v4-flash',
      "disabledMaterialComponentTypes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      "updatedByUserId" TEXT, "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

CREATE TABLE "GlobalLlmRoute" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "operationKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "reasoningMode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit', "updatedByUserId" TEXT,
      "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE ("provider", "operationKey")
    )

CREATE TABLE "GoalCreationSession" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "userId" TEXT NOT NULL, "threadId" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      "goalId" TEXT UNIQUE, "activeSlot" TEXT UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
      "phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'intake', "checkpointJson" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "currentRunId" TEXT,
      "firstUnitId" TEXT, "stopRequestedAt" TIMESTAMP(3), "stoppedAt" TIMESTAMP(3), "completedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
      "lastError" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      "nextEventSequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("threadId") REFERENCES "AgentThread" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY ("goalId") REFERENCES "LearningGoal" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "GoalCreationSessionEvent" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "sessionId" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
      "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" JSON NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY ("sessionId") REFERENCES "GoalCreationSession" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
      UNIQUE ("sessionId", "sequence")
    )

CREATE TABLE "GoalCreationSessionResource" (
      "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "sessionId" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'file',
      "filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "sourceUrl" TEXT, "canonicalUrl" TEXT, "provider" TEXT, "extractedText" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ready', "warning" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "error" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY ("sessionId") REFERENCES "GoalCreationSession" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE "GoalLearningSystemBinding" (
        "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        "goalId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "capabilityId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "enabled" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
        "configJson" JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
